procedure_text: (1)与实施例1所述步骤相同，得到含量为98.2％的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐；
procedure_summary: The methyl ester is cleaved by base to the sodium benzoate salt by the same procedure as an earlier worked example, leaving the benzylic bromide intact. Only the product identity and its stated content are printed here; no reagent, solvent, charge or condition is repeated.
notes: The whole of this step is the one cross-reference sentence (1)与实施例1所述步骤相同，得到含量为98.2％的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐； which is at once its heading and its procedure. NO PROCEDURE IS PRINTED HERE: no base, no solvent, no charge, no temperature, no time and no yield. Everything except the product identity and its stated content lives in Example 1, so conditions_inherited is true and both cross_reference_unresolved and conditions_unresolved are raised; the Example 1 record was not available to this call, so the inheritance could not be resolved rather than confirmed. reaction_class: the document establishes this transformation as removal of the methyl ester from methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate to give the alkali metal benzoate with the benzylic bromide untouched, which the patent itself calls an ester cleavage or base cleavage. hydrolysis is the closest class in the allowed list; ester_formation is the wrong direction and salt_formation alone would describe only the counter ion and lose the C-O bond cleavage. The product is nonetheless a salt, and the counter ion printed here is sodium. catalyst_class:base is tagged because the route the document establishes for this step uses a basic substance, although this section names none. methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate is emitted as the reactant on the strength of that route and of the last sentence of step (2), which names it as the basis of the stated yield; it is in A1 for this section with no quantity, so no a1_missing_compound is raised. precursor_step is null: nothing supplies the methyl ester within this document's registry, and the reference to Example 1 is a reference to a PROCEDURE, not a statement that Example 1's product was charged here, so writing Example 1::Step 1 as a precursor would assert a material link the text does not make. The cross-section reference is recorded in the linkage tag and in cross_reference_unresolved instead. A0 estimated three steps for this section and this annotation emits three, so the counts agree.

steps: strip the excess alcohol under reduced pressure with a high vacuum oil pump
seal the solid and set it aside for use
workup.concentration_method: stripping under reduced pressure with a high vacuum oil pump

process_control.criterion: stirred until the potassium hydride had dissolved completely

compounds.addition_profile: charged first into the reaction kettle, then stirring started
charged in at room temperature into the stirred alcohol, then stirred until dissolution was complete

procedure_text: 向反应釜中加入150mL  2-四氢呋喃甲醇，开动搅拌，室温下投入20g氢化钾(30％，0.15mol)，搅拌至溶解完全，经高真空油泵负压脱溶后得到2-四氢呋喃甲醇醇钾固体，密封备用。
procedure_summary: Potassium hydride is charged at room temperature into stirred tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol in a reaction kettle and stirred until it has dissolved completely, converting the alcohol into its potassium alkoxide. The excess alcohol is then stripped off under reduced pressure with a high vacuum oil pump and the solid alkoxide is sealed and set aside for use.
notes: The patent prints this preparation inside its step (2), in the first of that step's two paragraphs, but it is a transformation in its own right, with its own charge and its own isolated product, so it gets its own record. The step label Step 2a says where the document puts it while leaving the document's own marker for the etherification record that follows. A0 estimated three steps for this section and this annotation emits three, so the counts agree: the cross-referenced step (1), this alkoxide preparation, and the etherification. Tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol is both the medium and the reagent consumed, since the hydride is taken up in it and the excess is then stripped off, so it is carried as a reactant in agreement with A1, and solvent_class carries both neat, no separate solvent being added, and protic, the medium being an alcohol. reaction_class salt_formation is the closest of the permitted values: the alcohol is deprotonated and the product isolated is its potassium salt. Confidence is medium because no permitted class names alkoxide formation directly and the reaction also evolves hydrogen, which none of them covers; other was the alternative. mechanism_type ionic records the net transfer of the hydroxyl proton to the hydride, and the text states no mechanism. The 30 percent figure is printed as a strength on the hydride charge, with no word for solution anywhere in the paragraph, so it is carried as purity_pct on the compound as A1 does and conditions.concentration is left null; the printed mass, strength and mole figures close, so no molar_mass_inconsistent is raised and the working is in the provenance sidecar. THE TEXT SAYS THE HYDRIDE WAS STIRRED UNTIL IT HAD DISSOLVED COMPLETELY, which a solid hydride does not do; it is transcribed as printed and not reinterpreted as a solution or a dispersion of anything else, and the wording is recorded as the process control criterion. The hydride is charged in here rather than added dropwise, unlike the dropwise hydride additions printed elsewhere in this patent, and the addition_profile records what this paragraph says. No inert atmosphere, no reaction time and no stirrer type are printed, so those fields stay null even though a metal hydride is normally handled under inert gas; nothing is inferred, and the sealing of the solid is recorded as a workup step rather than read as an atmosphere. The vacuum stripping is recorded as the workup concentration method and not as a reaction pressure. No mass, content or yield is printed for the isolated alkoxide. The Chinese name this patent prints for the alcohol is not a well formed name, as A1 records; it is kept as printed and not corrected. safety_notes is empty because the paragraph carries no safety statement, and no hazard of my own is added.

conditions.cooling_method: kettle temperature held at 5 C through the portionwise addition and the hold
conditions.ph_target_stage: workup acidification of the aqueous kettle residue with concentrated hydrochloric acid to pH 3, after the solvent strip and before filtration

steps: strip the solvent under reduced pressure
add water to the kettle residue
add concentrated hydrochloric acid dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3
washes: water rinse of the filtered solid, volume not stated
workup.filtration: the acidified mixture is filtered and the solid collected

purification: no purification beyond the isolation: the acid is precipitated by acidification to pH 3, filtered off, rinsed with water and dried, and assayed by HPLC as isolated

compounds.addition_profile: the tetrahydrofuran is added to the solid alkoxide and stirred to dissolve it before the benzoate salt is charged; no amount is stated for the alkoxide
added to the solid alkoxide and stirred to dissolve it, then stripped under reduced pressure at the end of the step
added in eight portions with a total charging time of 3 h, at a controlled kettle temperature of 5 C
120 mL added to the kettle residue after the solvent strip and stirred to dissolve it; also used to rinse the filtered solid, where no amount is given
added dropwise as the concentrated acid to the dissolved kettle residue until the system reached pH 3, amount and strength not stated

procedure_text: 向2-四氢呋喃甲醇醇钾中加入200mL  THF，搅拌溶解后控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.2％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应3h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物33.1g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为97.0％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率92.2％。
procedure_summary: The solid potassium alkoxide is dissolved in tetrahydrofuran, the kettle is held cold, and the sodium benzoate salt made in the earlier step is charged portionwise, displacing the benzylic bromide to give the ether. After the hold the solvent is stripped, the residue is taken up in water and acidified with concentrated hydrochloric acid, and the precipitated free acid is filtered off, rinsed with water and dried, then assayed by liquid chromatography.
notes: Chinese heading: (2)2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示： Class: the benzylic bromide of the benzoate salt is displaced by the pre-formed potassium alkoxide of tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol, so nucleophilic_substitution is the transformation and Williamson ether synthesis is the named reaction. No base is charged in this paragraph, the nucleophile having been made in the preceding one, which is why catalyst_class is tagged none rather than base. Vessel: the alkoxide is dissolved and the kettle temperature is controlled, and the same sentence then says the benzoate salt was added into the reaction flask; the two vessel words are printed for what is evidently one vessel and are recorded as printed rather than reconciled. No vessel volume is printed, and no stirrer type is named, so stirring.type stays null. Temperature is the kettle temperature held at five degrees, and the cooling method field carries only the fact that the temperature was controlled there, since no coolant is named. time_h is the hold after the addition was complete; the total charging time is carried in the benzoate salt's addition_profile, not in time_h. Both figures happen to be printed as three hours and they are two separate numbers, not one repeated. Acid: the concentrated hydrochloric acid acidifies the dissolved kettle residue after the reaction and after the solvent strip, so it is a workup acidification and not a reagent of the substitution. It is kept in compounds with role acid, in workup, and as workup.ph_target, with the stage named in conditions.ph_target_stage; conditions.ph_value is left null because the pH number belongs to the workup rather than to the reaction. Drawing: the IMAGE_EXTRACT reaction scheme on line 569 is a single arrow whose reactant is the sodium benzoate salt and whose product is the free ether acid, matching the prose, with the potassium alkoxide and HCl as its arrow conditions. The alkoxide is drawn there as a structure with only the letters OK lettered in, so the drawing and the prose agree on potassium for the alkoxide and on sodium for the benzoate: the sodium versus potassium conflict this patent shows elsewhere does not arise in this section, and no drawing_text_conflict is raised. Two differences of completeness only, both recorded rather than flagged: the reaction solvent named in the prose does not appear on the arrow, which is how the schemes in this patent are drawn throughout rather than a chemical disagreement, so reagent_written_not_drawn is not raised for the omission of a solvent; and the hydrochloric acid drawn on the arrow is a workup acidification in the prose rather than a reagent of the substitution, so it is recorded in workup and noted rather than promoted to an arrow reagent. Because the drawing puts the acidification on the same arrow while the prose separates it by a solvent strip, is_one_pot is false. Linkage: the paragraph says in so many words that the benzoate salt charged here was prepared in step (1), and the identifier matches the product of Step 1 in this section, so precursor_step is Step 1 and linkage_confirmed is true under rule 24. precursor_step holds one value, so the other precursor is recorded here: the alkoxide this step is added to is the isolated product of Step 2a of this section. Yield basis: the yield the text prints is worded as a two-step yield calculated on methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate, whose charge is printed nowhere in this section, so the stated basis cannot be checked here. Taken against the benzoate salt actually charged to this step, the printed product mass and content reproduce the printed yield figure to within the rounding of those figures, which is only consistent with the stated two-step basis if step (1) is treated as quantitative. The figure is recorded in product_yield_pct as printed and its wording is left unchanged; the working is in the provenance sidecar. The product mass is below the theoretical mass from the stated charge, so no mass_balance_implausible is raised, and no printed mass and mole pair fails, so no molar_mass_inconsistent is raised. Step (1) prints no output quantity, so continuity between the two charges could not be checked in either direction and scale_discontinuity is neither raised nor treated as cleared. The stereodescriptor RS is printed in the prose but the drawn structure carries no stereo bond; the name is taken from the prose only. The liquid chromatography figure is a quantitative assay of the isolated product, not in-process monitoring, so it is recorded as the product content and process_control is left null.
